question: Which classes of sacred texts are enumerated alongside the purāṇas in this teaching?
premises: Purāṇas are named as a class of texts.
Various tantras are named alongside them.
The enumeration is addressed to the great Goddess.
inference: Both purāṇas and various tantras are included among the sacred texts.
plain_english: O great Goddess, the purāṇas and various tantras.
